text:
deploy-bot: Initiating staggered rollout v3.14.0 -> eu-west-1; slow-start +10% every 5m. Synthetic probes and healthchecks engaged. Monitoring window open.
sasha: Pause the ramp. embed-route p95 spiking in one AZ, need evidence before next bump.
matt: Can you drop the dashboard link? want traces + synth breakdown.
sasha: https://dashboards.redwood/prod/eu-west-1/synths — see panel "embed-route-synth"; p95 spike around 2026-02-18T12:33Z.
jamie: Found tokenizer allocation OOM on several canary pods in az-a.
jamie: ```
[embed-gen] ERROR 2026-02-18T12:33:02Z tok_alloc failed: OOM
pod=embed-canary-7 host=eu-west-1-a
```
oncall: Verified via quick tail: `kubectl -n prod logs -l app=embed --tail=150` — same OOM pattern on 3 pods in az-a.
tara: Proposal: restart affected pods in az-a and flip canary config to disable prefetch for canary only. also lower slow-start step to 5% to observe longer.
sasha: @deploy-bot set slow-start-inc 5 for next two steps. hold until 3 consecutive green synth cycles.
deploy-bot: Ack. slow-start increment updated to +5%. Next step scheduled in 180s.
matt: I'll prepare a targeted config patch: feature flag `ff_embed_prefetch=false` for canary subset.
jamie: Patch applied to canary, restarted 4 canary pods in az-a. initial tail logs show no further tok OOM after restart.
sasha: Synth check: 2 green cycles post-restart, p95 back within baseline for last 3m.
oncall: Temp rollback thresholds set tighter: error_rate >= 2% or p50 >200ms sustained 5m -> auto rollback.
matt: If it trips, we'll immediately pin embed-route to v3.13.9 and revert canary config.
tara: Follow canary-rollback runbook if needed: https://runbooks.redwood/canary-rollback — assign oncall to execute.
sasha: Bumping +5% now, current canary traffic 15%. watching closely.
oncall: Monitoring. will execute rollback pin on command: `deploy-bot traffic-pin embed-route v3.13.9`.
jamie: Observed elimination of memory tail once prefetch disabled on canary pods.
sasha: All good — synth 3/3 green, proceeding with gradual ramp per schedule. :thumbsup:
